notes:
- New **Settings › Privacy** page with **Send anonymous usage counts** (on by default) and **Reset ID**. The update check now carries a random ID, the version, your channel and your Windows version so installs can be counted. Off sends no ID and nothing about your PC. Never audio, text, names or keys. See [Anonymous usage counts](/docs/privacy/).
- Download now opens a short "your download is starting" page that shows the two Windows prompts to click through (the browser's **Keep**, then **More info** and **Run anyway**), and the installer's first screen says you will not see them again.
- **Settings › Account** says it plainly: Transcribe is free, always. Notes (meetings, voices, search) will become a one-time purchase later, with 30 days free first, and nothing you have recorded is ever locked away.
